summary.text: Bill Wiley is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 32, representing part of Frederick County and the city of Winchester, serving since November 19, 2020. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Transportation, General Laws, and Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: William D. (Bill) Wiley was born in Roanoke, Virginia, according to the House's member profile.
The profile says he earned a B.S. in economics from George Mason University in 1993 and a master's in education there in 1998, and lists his occupation as business development.
The profile lists his military service as the Virginia Army National Guard from 1990 to 1998.
